name: legion-worker-codegraph
description: The CodeGraph CLI the worker image puts on its PATH, installed from this directory's bun.lock with `bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` (worker.Dockerfile's plugin stage). @colbymchenry/codegraph is pinned to the version the devbox runs (`codegraph --version`), and this is the one place that names it: the plugin stage copies the per-platform bundle out of the install, and the notices stage reads the pin from this file for the LICENSE of that release. Everything Bun installs beside it, the per-platform bundle included, is pinned by the lockfile alone.
